harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s reconciliation job with non-blocking flock exclusivity. Concurrent runs now produce one winner and one clear exit-75 “already running” result. Interrupted runs release the lock, ledger entries remain unique, and all behavior persisted through a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Updated /srv/legacy2/batch-exclusive-lock/bin/reconcile using the installed util-linux flock.
Used exact fixed-string ledger checks and preserved the existing B100 entry.
Verified concurrency, duplicate pending IDs, interruption recovery, idempotence, and cleanup.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its changed boot identity and full recovery.
Kept RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, installed packages, SELinux enforcement, and SSH access unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Only one invocation processes pending.tsv and contention leaves a clear result
evidence.summary: Concurrent tests before and after restart produced one status-0 winner and one status-75 loser with an explicit “already running” message.

evidence.requirement: Each batch ID reaches ledger.tsv exactly once while existing entries are preserved
evidence.summary: The original B100 entry remains; production contains B100, B101, and B102 once each with zero duplicate lines.

evidence.requirement: An interrupted invocation does not permanently block later work
evidence.summary: After terminating the active invocation with status 143, an immediate subsequent run returned 0 and completed every test ID exactly once.

evidence.requirement: Repair is installed, compatible, clean, and idempotent
evidence.summary: The POSIX shell script passed syntax checks, uses installed flock, leaves production hashes unchanged on repeat runs, and has no temporary residue or reconciliation processes.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe; the reboot was acknowledged; post-restart ID was 240fc8e4-5d32-4f73-929f-4f2581f9a98e; system, SSH, script, lock, and ledger fully recovered.
